# fabric_bastion (Data Source)

Resolve the caller's FABRIC bastion host and login from the configured token, via the FABRIC Core API. Use it to SSH to slice nodes through the bastion without hardcoding the username.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `core_api_url` (String) FABRIC Core API base URL. Defaults to `https://uis.fabric-testbed.net`.
- `host` (String) Bastion hostname. Defaults to `bastion.fabric-testbed.net`.

### Read-Only

- `email` (String) The caller's FABRIC account email.
- `id` (String) The caller's FABRIC user UUID.
- `username` (String) The caller's FABRIC bastion login.
- `uuid` (String) The caller's FABRIC user UUID.
